accepted_risk.reason: Triple-failure chain. Probability <0.01%. Cost of fix exceeds expected loss.
Advisory lock prevents double execution. SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock is <1ms overhead. Not worth single-worker complexity.
Acknowledged tech debt. 3 branches (PICKING/CONTEO/PACKING) with distinct imports. Future sprint.
Documented design choice: uses first item's data when product not found in OC. WARNING logged. Alternative (skip item) worse.
Logged at CRITICAL level (line 640). In scheduler context, re-raise would crash the job without benefit.
Deferred bulk-zero is better than pre-zero. On restart, old quantities remain (no data loss), next sync fixes it.
By design: Siesa call is async via DLQ. State AJUSTANDO is correct intermediate state. Client polls for AJUSTADO.
Prewarm is read-only (GET Siesa + cache). Worst case: duplicate HTTP requests. Not data corruption.
Design choice: prevents Siesa overload. Scheduler re-runs periodically, B/C will be prewarmed eventually.
Code checks for existing jobs in ALL states (PENDIENTE/PROCESANDO/REINTENTANDO/FALLIDO/COMPLETADO). Risk is only if job was deleted from DB.
App-level invariant enforced in confirmar_ajuste flow. DB constraint not needed — state machine is sequential.
No FK by design. MovimientoInventario references tarea via numero_documento. Adding FK requires migration + backward compat.
Watchdog failure is already captured in 'parciales' list and included in scheduler alert email.
Dedup via query filter works (checks PENDIENTE/PROCESANDO/FALLIDO). Formal idempotency_key column not needed.
On restart, scheduler re-runs and regenerates. Duplicate tasks prevented by sesiones_activas check.
Per-lot flush + single final commit = atomic. No partial state possible.

ACCEPTED RISK pre-launch. DLQ + reconciliacion run every 5min — max gap after restart is 5min, self-healing via advisory locks + idempotency (siesa_triggered). Cron jobs (2am/3am) skipping once per rare restart is recoverable via manual trigger. SQLAlchemyJobStore deferred to post-launch: requires new DB table, distribution logic for 2 Gunicorn workers, and integration risk not justified before production validation.

ACCEPTED RISK pre-launch. registrar_conteo debounce is per-worker but with_for_update() on SesionConteo provides row-level serialization.
